ثممت (form I)
# ثَمَمْتُ (ṯamamtu) /θa.mam.tu/: first-person singular past active of ثَمَّ (ṯamma)
# ثَمَمْتَ (ṯamamta) /θa.mam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of ثَمَّ (ṯamma)
# ثَمَمْتِ (ṯamamti) /θa.mam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of ثَمَّ (ṯamma)
# ثُمِمْتُ (ṯumimtu) /θu.mim.tu/: first-person singular past passive of ثَمَّ (ṯamma)
# ثُمِمْتَ (ṯumimta) /θu
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
